items.source: Bean post-processor that automatically applies persistence exception translation to any bean marked with Spring's @Repository annotation, adding a corresponding PersistenceExceptionTranslationAdvisor to the exposed proxy (either an existing AOP proxy or a newly generated proxy that implements all of the target's interfaces).
items.translation: 自动将持久化异常转换应用于任何标记有 Spring 的 `@Repository` 注解的 bean 的 Bean 后处理器，向暴露的代理（现有的 AOP 代理或新生成的实现目标所有接口的代理）添加相应的 `PersistenceExceptionTranslationAdvisor`。

items.source: A convenient BeanPostProcessor that applies a concurrency interceptor to all bean methods annotated with @ConcurrencyLimit.
items.translation: 一个方便的BeanPostProcessor，它会对所有带有@ConcurrencyLimit注解的 bean 方法应用并发拦截器。

items.source: A convenient BeanPostProcessor that applies a retry interceptor to all bean methods annotated with @Retryable.
items.translation: 一个方便的BeanPostProcessor，它会对所有带有@Retryable注解的 bean 方法应用重试拦截器。

items.source: Bean post-processor that automatically applies asynchronous invocation behavior to any bean that carries the Async annotation at class or method-level by adding a corresponding AsyncAnnotationAdvisor to the exposed proxy (either an existing AOP proxy or a newly generated proxy that implements all the target's interfaces).
items.translation: 自动将异步调用行为应用于任何在类或方法级别携带 Async 注解的 Bean 的后处理器，通过向暴露的代理（现有的 AOP 代理或新生成的实现目标所有接口的代理）添加相应的 AsyncAnnotationAdvisor。

items.source: A convenient BeanPostProcessor implementation that delegates to a JSR-303 provider for performing method-level validation on annotated methods.
items.translation: 一个方便的BeanPostProcessor实现，它委托给 JSR-303 提供者以在注释的方法上执行方法级验证。
`AbstractBeanFactoryAwareAdvisingPostProcessor` 类在 `org.springframework.dao.annotation` 包中的使用情况

items.source: Annotation-based retry and concurrency limit support.
items.translation: 基于注解的重试和并发限制支持。

items.source: Annotation support for asynchronous method execution.
items.translation: 支持异步方法执行的注解。

items.source:
Support classes for integrating a JSR-303 Bean Validation provider
(such as Hibernate Validator) into a Spring ApplicationContext
and in particular with Spring's data binding and validation APIs.
items.translation: 支持将 JSR-303 Bean Validation 提供者（例如 Hibernate Validator）集成到 Spring ApplicationContext 中的辅助类，特别是与 Spring 的数据绑定和验证 API 一起使用。
